name: aios-markdown-auto-preview
description: When a Markdown file opens as source (e.g. from a Claude Code chat link), automatically reopen it as rendered preview.

markdownAutoPreview.enabled.description: Automatically reopen Markdown files that open as source (e.g. from a Claude Code chat link) in rendered preview.

markdownAutoPreview.debug.description: Log tab events and swap decisions to the 'AIOS Markdown Auto-Preview' output channel (for troubleshooting).

commands.title: AIOS: Open This Markdown as Source
